topic.title: Adaptive Decoding and Efficient Sequence Generation
topic.area: Language Models and Natural Language Processing
topic.overview: Generating sequences quickly requires deciding which tokens or blocks can be produced together without sacrificing coherence. This topic studies adaptive computation, speculative decoding, diffusion-language generation, caching, and tokenization. The key question is how much sequential work is truly necessary for a given input and quality target.
topic.whyItMatters: Parallel generation can improve throughput while introducing dependencies that simple token confidence does not capture. Drafting and verification add their own overhead, so speed must be measured under realistic workloads alongside output quality. A tunable trade-off is different from a guarantee of preserving the original sampling distribution.
topic.evolution: A 2010 representative improves memory and inference for a sequence-memoizer language model. Later work explores adaptive computation and constrained decoding. Adaptive parallel decoding in 2025 combines diffusion marginals with an auxiliary autoregressive model; a 2026 method uses historical contexts to improve coherence and reduce degradation when many tokens are decoded in parallel.
openQuestions: Which signals reliably indicate that a block can be generated without further refinement?
How should decoding adapt to different sequence lengths, hardware, and quality requirements?

papers.title: Lookahead Unmasking Elicits Accurate Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: LookUM improves diffusion-language decoding by comparing a few unmasking paths using sequence uncertainty.

papers.title: LUGS: Latent-aware Guidance for Efficient Unmasking in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.tldr: LUGS uses internal hidden states to guide token unmasking, improving diffusion language-model performance across the evaluated tasks.

papers.title: MineDraft: A Framework for Batch Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.tldr: MineDraft overlaps drafting and verification across two request batches, improving throughput and latency over standard speculative decoding.

papers.title: Mitigating Bias in Locally Constrained Decoding via Tractable Proposals
papers.tldr: GPU-friendly global constraint proposals help sequential Monte Carlo sample valid language-model outputs with less bias and fewer particles.

papers.title: Mosaic: Unlocking Over 30$\times$ Context Length for Diffusion LLMs Inference via Global Memory Planning and Dynamic Peak Taming
papers.tldr: Mosaic reorganizes diffusion language model inference memory to support 15.30×–32.34× longer sequences while preserving exact outputs.

papers.title: NITP: Next Implicit Token Prediction for LLM Pre-training
papers.tldr: NITP supplements next-token prediction with continuous representation targets, improving downstream results with little extra training computation.

papers.title: Non-Monotonic Autoregressive Sequence Model
papers.tldr: N-MARS teaches autoregressive models to retract previous tokens through a learned erase action and correction-focused training.

papers.title: On Stable Long-Form Generation: Benchmarking and Mitigating Length Volatility
papers.tldr: VOLTBench measures unstable long-form output lengths, and SELB reduces that volatility through a training-free decoding intervention.

papers.title: Optimality of FSQ Tokens for Continuous Diffusion for Categorical Data with Application to Text-to-Speech
papers.tldr: Theory and text-to-speech experiments identify FSQ token geometry as especially well suited to continuous diffusion over categorical data.

papers.title: Plan for Speed: Dilated Scheduling for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: DUS unmasks spaced token groups in parallel, improving the quality-speed trade-off of masked diffusion decoding without changing the denoiser.

papers.title: PRISM: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: LLaDA-S combines hierarchical search, self-verification, and partial remasking to improve diffusion-language-model inference efficiency.

papers.title: Progressive Cramming: Reliable Token Compression and What It Reveals
papers.tldr: Progressive cramming shows that perfect text reconstruction can coexist with severe downstream capability loss.

papers.title: Proxy Compression for Language Modeling
papers.tldr: Proxy compression trains on both compressed text and raw bytes to improve efficiency while keeping inference entirely byte-based.

papers.title: Reasoning Cache: Continual Improvement Over Long Horizons via Short-Horizon RL
papers.tldr: Reasoning Cache uses iterative summary-conditioned reasoning to turn short-budget training into effective reasoning over much larger test-time budgets.

papers.title: Residual Context Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: RCD recycles discarded diffusion-token representations as context, improving reported accuracy and reducing denoising steps needed to match baseline performance.

papers.title: Rooted Absorbed Prefix Trajectory Balance with Submodular Replay for GFlowNet Training
papers.tldr: RapTB and submodular replay improve prefix credit assignment and sampling diversity in GFlowNet language-model training.

papers.title: Sampling from Your Language Model One Byte at a Time
papers.tldr: An inference-time conversion enables byte- or character-level sampling from BPE language models, resolving prompt-boundary distortion and supporting cross-tokenizer combinations.

papers.title: Scaling Beyond Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: Scaling comparisons show that uniform-state diffusion can remain competitive and outperform masked diffusion on GSM8K despite worse validation perplexity.

papers.title: Scheduling Thoughts: Learning the Order of Thought in Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: Self-Aware Scheduling learns token-reveal orders that improve masked diffusion models using a theoretically motivated reward.

papers.title: Search or Accelerate: Confidence-Switched Position Beam Search for Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: SOAR uses confidence to alternate between exploring unmasking orders and fast parallel decoding in diffusion language models.

papers.title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: SARDI retrieves evidence from intermediate diffusion drafts, improving multi-hop question answering with up to five times higher throughput than the compared baselines.

papers.title: Set Diffusion: Interpolating Token Orderings between Autoregression and Diffusion for Fast and Flexible Decoding
papers.tldr: Set diffusion generates flexible token sets with per-step caching, improving reported speed–quality tradeoffs and infilling performance.

papers.title: Simple Denoising Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: A loss focused on noise-replaced tokens simplifies diffusion-language-model training, while an efficient regularizer further improves performance.

papers.title: Singular Proxies for Adaptive Caching in Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: SPA-Cache accelerates diffusion language models with cheap token-update selection and adaptive update budgets across layers.

papers.title: Speculative Coupled Decoding for Training-Free Lossless Acceleration of Autoregressive Visual Generation
papers.tldr: Coupling draft samples across iterations accelerates lossless visual decoding by up to 4.2× for images and 13.6× for video.

papers.title: SPEED-Bench: A Unified and Diverse Benchmark for Speculative Decoding
papers.tldr: SPEED-Bench evaluates speculative decoding with diverse inputs and realistic serving loads to reveal workload-dependent performance.

papers.title: SPEED: Sharpened-Teacher Distillation for Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: SPEED combines selective teacher distillation with context-sensitive token grouping to accelerate diffusion decoding while keeping accuracy close to greedy decoding.

papers.title: Stop the Flip-Flop: Context-Preserving Verification for Fast Revocable Diffusion Decoding
papers.tldr: COVER speeds diffusion decoding by verifying selected tokens while preserving their context for other predictions, reducing wasteful revision cycles.

papers.title: Swordsman: Entropy-Driven Adaptive Block Partition for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: Swordsman uses entropy shifts and adaptive unmasking thresholds to improve diffusion language model decoding without additional training.

papers.title: TEAM: Temporal–Spatial Consistency Guided Expert Activation for MoE Diffusion Language Model Acceleration
papers.tldr: TEAM exploits routing consistency to reduce expert activation and increase accepted tokens, accelerating MoE diffusion language models by up to 2.2 times.

papers.title: Temperature Scaling in Discrete Sequence (Language) Models
papers.tldr: New fine-tuning objectives and likelihood-ratio metrics make sequence-level temperature scaling more tractable and measurable.

papers.title: The Efficiency Gap in Byte Modeling
papers.tldr: A compute-matched scaling study finds that byte modeling incurs a larger scaling penalty for masked diffusion than for autoregressive models.

papers.title: The Hidden Cost of Structured Generation in LLMs: Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding
papers.tldr: Generating an unconstrained draft before constrained decoding improves structured-answer accuracy by reducing the distortion caused by format enforcement.

papers.title: The Safety-Aware Denoiser for Text Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: SAD adds safety constraints to text diffusion denoising at inference time, reducing reported unsafe generations without retraining the model.

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: Speculating over denoising trajectories accelerates diffusion language models while explicitly accounting for the trajectory drift introduced by greater parallelism.

papers.title: Unifying Masked Diffusion Models with Various Generation Orders and Beyond
papers.tldr: LoMDM jointly learns context-dependent generation order and a masked diffusion backbone within a framework spanning several generation styles.

papers.title: UnMaskFork: Test-Time Scaling for Masked Diffusion via Deterministic Action Branching
papers.tldr: UnMaskFork searches deterministic partial-unmasking trajectories to improve masked-diffusion reasoning with additional inference computation.

papers.title: Variational Speculative Decoding: Rethinking Draft Training from Token Likelihood to Sequence Acceptance
papers.tldr: VSD trains speculative draft models for sequence acceptance and reports up to 9.58% speedup over EAGLE-3 and 8.80% over ViSpec.

papers.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
papers.tldr: VIA-SD adds a routed slim verifier between acceptance and full-model verification, delivering reported speedups over strong speculative-decoding baselines.

papers.title: WeDLM: Reconciling Diffusion Language Models with Standard Causal Attention for Fast Inference
papers.tldr: WeDLM combines reordered causal attention with streaming diffusion decoding to achieve practical speedups while retaining prefix caching and evaluated generation quality.

papers.title: When Drafts Evolve: Speculative Decoding Meets Online Learning
papers.tldr: OnlineSPEC adapts speculative draft models using existing verification feedback, linking online learning to acceleration and reporting speedups up to 24%.

papers.title: WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching
papers.tldr: WorldCache adapts feature reuse to token predictability and drift, delivering up to 3.7× reported speedup while maintaining 98% rollout quality.

papers.title: XSpecMesh: Quality-Preserving Auto-Regressive Mesh Generation Acceleration via Multi-Head Speculative Decoding
papers.tldr: XSpecMesh uses parallel token proposals, backbone verification, and distillation to achieve a reported 1.7-fold mesh-generation speedup without quality loss.

papers.title: You Can Learn Tokenization End-to-End with Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Reinforcement-learning variance reduction makes direct optimization of discrete token boundaries practical, outperforming straight-through estimates at the 100-million-parameter scale.
